_about: In His Steps' library: the only works Claude may quote, and the app (never Claude) builds
every link from this file. MADE BY tools/make_christian_sources.py: edit that, not this.
Then download the texts:  $env:EDITION = "christian"; uv run python tools/build_sources.py
Scripture is the Berean Standard Bible (public domain since 2023), linked to Bible Hub.
Writers come from the Christian Classics Ethereal Library (CCEL), Project Gutenberg, or
Wikisource (Augustine and Aquinas, shared with Reflections). Writers still in copyright
(C. S. Lewis, Bonhoeffer, Dallas Willard, Tim Keller, Oswald Chambers) are not listed:
Claude may paraphrase and name them, but never quote them.
See editions/philosophy/sources.json for what each field means.

psalms.title: Psalms
psalms.location_format: chapter:verse, e.g. 3:16 (or chapter:verse-verse for a short run, e.g. 3:16-17)
psalms.note: Prayer in every mood: lament, confession (32, 51), trust (23, 27, 46, 62, 91), longing (42, 63, 84), searching the heart (139), praise. Give the speaker's honest feelings their due before turning to hope.

proverbs.title: Proverbs
proverbs.location_format: chapter:verse, e.g. 3:16 (or chapter:verse-verse for a short run, e.g. 3:16-17)
proverbs.note: Wisdom for daily conduct: speech, work, friendship, money, pride and humility, the fear of the LORD (1, 3, 4, 16).

ecclesiastes.title: Ecclesiastes
ecclesiastes.location_format: chapter:verse, e.g. 3:16 (or chapter:verse-verse for a short run, e.g. 3:16-17)
ecclesiastes.note: The Teacher on vanity, toil, time and seasons (3), enjoying God's gifts, and what endures (12). Call the author 'the Teacher' (the book's own name for him, traditionally Solomon): 'the Teacher of Ecclesiastes' on first mention, then just 'the Teacher' or 'he'.

isaiah.title: Isaiah
isaiah.location_format: chapter:verse, e.g. 3:16 (or chapter:verse-verse for a short run, e.g. 3:16-17)
isaiah.note: Comfort and calling: the vision of holiness (6), comfort for the weary (40), the Servant (42, 53), invitation (55).

matthew.title: Matthew
matthew.location_format: chapter:verse, e.g. 3:16 (or chapter:verse-verse for a short run, e.g. 3:16-17)
matthew.note: The Sermon on the Mount (5-7): the Beatitudes, anger, lust, enemies, giving and prayer in secret, treasure, worry, judging, the narrow gate. Parables (13, 18, 20, 25). The weary invited to rest (11:28-30).

mark.title: Mark
mark.location_format: chapter:verse, e.g. 3:16 (or chapter:verse-verse for a short run, e.g. 3:16-17)
mark.note: Jesus in action: the cost of following (8:34-38), service (10:42-45), faith and doubt (9:24), Gethsemane (14).

luke.title: Luke
luke.location_format: chapter:verse, e.g. 3:16 (or chapter:verse-verse for a short run, e.g. 3:16-17)
luke.note: Parables of grace: the Good Samaritan (10), Mary and Martha (10), the rich fool (12), the lost sheep, coin and son (15), the Pharisee and the tax collector (18). Zacchaeus (19).

john.title: John
john.location_format: chapter:verse, e.g. 3:16 (or chapter:verse-verse for a short run, e.g. 3:16-17)
john.note: The Word made flesh (1), new birth (3), living water (4), the 'I am' sayings, washing feet (13), abiding in the vine (15), the high-priestly prayer (17), Peter restored (21).

romans.title: Romans
romans.location_format: chapter:verse, e.g. 3:16 (or chapter:verse-verse for a short run, e.g. 3:16-17)
romans.note: Paul's fullest gospel: all have sinned (3), justified by faith (5), dead to sin (6), the divided self (7), no condemnation and life in the Spirit (8), living sacrifices and transformed minds (12).

1_corinthians.title: 1 Corinthians
1_corinthians.location_format: chapter:verse, e.g. 3:16 (or chapter:verse-verse for a short run, e.g. 3:16-17)
1_corinthians.note: The foolishness of the cross (1), the body (12), love (13), resurrection hope (15).

2_corinthians.title: 2 Corinthians
2_corinthians.location_format: chapter:verse, e.g. 3:16 (or chapter:verse-verse for a short run, e.g. 3:16-17)
2_corinthians.note: Comfort in affliction (1), treasure in jars of clay (4), new creation (5), strength in weakness (12).

galatians.title: Galatians
galatians.location_format: chapter:verse, e.g. 3:16 (or chapter:verse-verse for a short run, e.g. 3:16-17)
galatians.note: Freedom in Christ, not by works of the law (2:20, 5:1), the fruit of the Spirit against the works of the flesh (5), bearing one another's burdens (6).

ephesians.title: Ephesians
ephesians.location_format: chapter:verse, e.g. 3:16 (or chapter:verse-verse for a short run, e.g. 3:16-17)
ephesians.note: Saved by grace through faith (2), rooted in love (3), the old self and the new (4), speech and anger (4), walking as children of light (5), the armour of God (6).

philippians.title: Philippians
philippians.location_format: chapter:verse, e.g. 3:16 (or chapter:verse-verse for a short run, e.g. 3:16-17)
philippians.note: The mind of Christ and his humility (2), counting all as loss (3), pressing on (3), anxiety and peace, whatever is true, contentment in all circumstances (4).

colossians.title: Colossians
colossians.location_format: chapter:verse, e.g. 3:16 (or chapter:verse-verse for a short run, e.g. 3:16-17)
colossians.note: Setting your mind on things above, putting off and putting on (3), work done as for the Lord (3).

1_thessalonians.title: 1 Thessalonians
1_thessalonians.location_format: chapter:verse, e.g. 3:16 (or chapter:verse-verse for a short run, e.g. 3:16-17)
1_thessalonians.note: A quiet life (4), grief with hope (4), rejoice always, pray without ceasing, give thanks (5).

2_timothy.title: 2 Timothy
2_timothy.location_format: chapter:verse, e.g. 3:16 (or chapter:verse-verse for a short run, e.g. 3:16-17)
2_timothy.note: Not a spirit of fear (1), endurance (2), Scripture (3), finishing the race (4).

hebrews.title: Hebrews
hebrews.location_format: chapter:verse, e.g. 3:16 (or chapter:verse-verse for a short run, e.g. 3:16-17)
hebrews.note: A high priest who sympathises with weakness (4), faith (11), running the race and discipline (12), contentment (13).

james.title: James
james.location_format: chapter:verse, e.g. 3:16 (or chapter:verse-verse for a short run, e.g. 3:16-17)
james.note: Trials and wisdom (1), doers of the word (1), favouritism (2), faith and works (2), the tongue (3), humility and planning (4), patience (5).

1_peter.title: 1 Peter
1_peter.location_format: chapter:verse, e.g. 3:16 (or chapter:verse-verse for a short run, e.g. 3:16-17)
1_peter.note: Living hope (1), suffering for doing good (2-4), casting your anxieties on him (5:7), humility (5).

1_john.title: 1 John
1_john.location_format: chapter:verse, e.g. 3:16 (or chapter:verse-verse for a short run, e.g. 3:16-17)
1_john.note: Walking in the light, confession and forgiveness (1), love for one another, God is love (4), assurance (5).

confessions.author: Augustine
confessions.title: Confessions
confessions.work_page: Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers: Series I/Volume I/Confessions

pages.prefix: Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers: Series I/Volume I/Confessions/

confessions.note: The restless heart (1.1), disordered loves, the divided will (8), conversion in the garden (8.12), memory and longing for God (10). Augustine speaks to God throughout: quote it as prayer.

summa.author: Thomas Aquinas
summa.title: Summa Theologiae
summa.translation: Fathers of the English Dominican Province (1917)
summa.location_format: part.question.article, e.g. I-II.2.8 (only the moral parts I-II and II-II are available)
summa.note: Use it for grace (I-II.109-114), the theological virtues of faith, hope and charity (II-II.1-46), humility and pride (II-II.161-162), sloth (II-II.35). Quote the body of an article or a reply, not the objections, which state views Aquinas rejects.

pages.pattern: ^(First Part of the Second Part|Second Part of the Second Part)/Question (\d+)$

luther_liberty.author: Martin Luther
luther_liberty.title: Concerning Christian Liberty
luther_liberty.note: Also known as The Freedom of a Christian (1520): the Christian is a free lord of all, subject to none, and a dutiful servant of all, subject to all; faith alone justifies, and good works flow from a heart already set free.

calvin_christian_life.author: John Calvin
calvin_christian_life.title: On the Christian Life
calvin_christian_life.note: Institutes III.6-10, often printed as the Golden Booklet: self-denial ('we are not our own'), bearing the cross, meditating on the life to come, using this life's gifts rightly.

bunyan_pilgrim.author: John Bunyan
bunyan_pilgrim.title: The Pilgrim's Progress
bunyan_pilgrim.location_format: part and stage, e.g. Part I, The Third Stage
bunyan_pilgrim.note: Christian's journey: the burden at the cross, the Slough of Despond, the Interpreter's house, Vanity Fair, Doubting Castle and Giant Despair, the River. Characters speak the lines; name them.

bunyan_grace.author: John Bunyan
bunyan_grace.title: Grace Abounding to the Chief of Sinners
bunyan_grace.note: Bunyan's own story of doubt, temptation, despair and assurance: honest about a troubled conscience.

edwards_affections.author: Jonathan Edwards
edwards_affections.title: Religious Affections
edwards_affections.location_format: part and numbered sign, e.g. Part III, XII (or just Part I)
edwards_affections.note: Telling true religion from its imitations: 'true religion, in great part, consists in holy affections'; feelings are no proof either way; the sign of real grace is a changed life and practice.

lawrence_practice.author: Brother Lawrence
lawrence_practice.title: The Practice of the Presence of God
lawrence_practice.location_format: conversation or letter, e.g. Fourth Conversation or Second Letter
lawrence_practice.note: A kitchen worker's habit of constant, simple conversation with God among the pots and pans; returning without fuss after distraction.

murray_prayer.author: Andrew Murray
murray_prayer.title: With Christ in the School of Prayer
murray_prayer.note: Thirty-one lessons on prayer from Jesus' own words: praying in secret, asking with confidence, persevering, the Father's love.

murray_humility.author: Andrew Murray
murray_humility.title: Humility: The Beauty of Holiness
murray_humility.note: Humility as the creature's proper place before God and the root of every virtue; pride as the root of sin; humility tested in daily life, among other people, more than in prayer.

spurgeon_morning_evening.author: Charles Spurgeon
spurgeon_morning_evening.title: Morning and Evening
spurgeon_morning_evening.location_format: reading, e.g. Morning, January 14 or Evening, March 3
spurgeon_morning_evening.note: Daily devotional readings, each on one verse: warm, vivid, Christ-centred.

ryle_holiness.author: J. C. Ryle
ryle_holiness.title: Holiness
ryle_holiness.note: Plain, searching chapters: sin, sanctification, the fight, the cost, growth, assurance, 'Lot: a Beacon', 'Remember Lot's Wife', 'Christ is All'.

owen_mortification.author: John Owen
owen_mortification.title: Of the Mortification of Sin in Believers
owen_mortification.note: Putting sin to death by the Spirit (Romans 8:13): 'be killing sin or it will be killing you'; dealing with the root, not just the symptom; looking to Christ.

tozer_pursuit.author: A. W. Tozer
tozer_pursuit.title: The Pursuit of God
tozer_pursuit.note: Hungering for God himself rather than for religion: possessing nothing, removing the veil, the gaze of the soul, the sacrament of ordinary living.

baxter_rest.author: Richard Baxter
baxter_rest.title: The Saints' Everlasting Rest
baxter_rest.translation: original English (1650), abridged by Benjamin Fawcett
baxter_rest.note: Heaven as the believer's rest, and the habit of heavenly meditation as medicine for a troubled, earth-bound heart.

kempis_imitation.author: Thomas à Kempis
kempis_imitation.title: The Imitation of Christ
kempis_imitation.location_format: book and chapter, e.g. Book 1, Chapter 3
kempis_imitation.note: Short chapters on humility, inner peace, self-knowledge, bearing others' faults, and following Christ. Book 4 is on the Sacrament: rarely the right lens here.
